# Offline folder choices stay pending until the picker applies its accepted set difference

The replacement picker seeds a fresh adapter from existing Offline flags and changes row properties while open. Acceptance sets folders newly chosen and clears folders removed from the initial set. This replaces the legacy immediate writes and cancel rollback map. Account settings passes one server, while the standalone synchronization dialog still opens without server arguments. Source tests assert final NNTP/IMAP/EWS Offline folder sets after accepting, not cancellation or restart persistence. No dialog or test ran.

Scope: Offline folder selection state boundary.
